newsitem.title: FRANCE: Synthelabo sees 10 pct sales rise in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Synthelabo sees 10 pct sales rise in 1996.

text.p: Pharmaceutical group Synthelabo said it expected a 10 percent sales rise in the full year 1996 and also foresaw a rise in its net income.
It made the forecast in a financial advertisement in which it said that operating income over the first half of 1996 was up by 26.9 percent to 763.5 million francs.
Profit before taxes, minorities and asset losses was up 20 percent to 710.3 million francs from 591.80 million.
Six month sales were up 10.2 percent to 5,122.6 million from 4,648.8 million.
It said the rise in profits was due to the good performance of its main products in Europe and the success of Stilnox in the U.S.
